title: ChugLookAndFeel — gate-state accents, mechanical feel, correct JUCE overrides
description:
Implement Source/GUI/ChugLookAndFeel as the project LookAndFeel_V4 subclass driving the mechanical/precise visual identity (spec §21.2).

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §21.1–21.2 (window, visual identity: dark neutral base, bright gate-state accents, color-blind-safe state symbols, restrained animation)
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §7.1 Performance State Engine states (for accent colors / state symbols)
- Known JUCE API: juce::LookAndFeel_V4 override signatures only — do not invent undocumented LookAndFeel methods
- Existing Source/PluginEditor.* skeleton for how L&F will later be owned

Implement ChugLookAndFeel.h/.cpp:
- Subclass juce::LookAndFeel_V4 with a suite-consistent dark palette (background, panel, outline, text, muted text).
- Gate-state accent colors and optional monochrome/shape symbol helpers for CLOSED / OPEN / HOLD / ATTACK / SUSTAIN / RELEASE / FEEDBACK / (and any other engine states present in codebase enums).
- Correct V4 overrides for rotary sliders, linear sliders, buttons, combo boxes, labels, tabs, and scrollbars so controls read as fast/mechanical/precise (sharp corners or tight radii, high-contrast tracks, restrained glow).
- Public palette accessors (e.g. getStateColour, getKeyTraceColour, getAudioTraceColour, getThresholdColour) so timeline and indicator components can share colors without hard-coding hex.
- Color-blind-safe: pair hue with distinct shape/character symbols where state is shown as a lamp/badge API helper.
- No audio DSP, no APVTS attachments, no page composition.

Do NOT implement PerformanceTimeline, StateIndicator, pages, MainHeader, PluginEditor wiring, or CMakeLists.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: ChugLookAndFeel provides gate-state accent colour/symbol accessors usable by later GUI components
LookAndFeel_V4 drawing overrides for core controls (slider/button/combo/label/tab) are implemented in ChugLookAndFeel.cpp
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: override standard LookAndFeel_V4 drawing methods with a shared dark palette
define a compact gate-state colour table keyed by engine state enum or int
expose trace/threshold colours for timeline painters
forbidden: introduce custom GUI frameworks outside JUCE
embed page layout or parameter attachment logic in LookAndFeel
